author: Frank Wahl
text: There is a difference between what is shown in the Graph and the actual measured value. Even though you might get a low alarm this won't necessarily show up on the Graphical representation. The Graph shows you averages if (I think) 5 Minutes. So...if you just hit a 'low' for a minute this does not show up in the Graph. Although your Sensor will trigger this alarm.

author: Steve Kuckuk
text: It can (may) take over 24 hours (24 - 48) for the sensor to 'settle in' (reduce inflammation from knife blade's inserting the sensor’s filament) and give stabile readings . . . 'For me', I put the new sensor on my skin a full day ahead of needing it and then activate the new sensor a day later when the old one expires . . . The 14/15 days of usefulness counter will not begin until activation . . .
